entries.head: shape up

example.en: He started running to shape up before the wedding.
example.zh: 婚礼前他开始跑步练身材。

entries.l1_note: 变结实是 shape up；不是“塑形”直译 shape the body。

entries.head: bulk up

example.en: He's bulking up before the competition.

entries.l1_note: 增肌是 bulk up；bulk 单独是体积。

entries.head: slim down

example.en: She slimmed down after cutting out late-night snacks.
example.zh: 戒了夜宵之后她瘦下来了。

entries.l1_note: 瘦下来是 slim down；不是 become slim down（多了 become）。

entries.head: tone up

example.en: She tones up with light weights twice a week.
example.zh: 她每周两次小重量练线条。

entries.l1_note: 练紧实是 tone up；tone down 是放软语气。

entries.head: keep at

example.en: Keep at it — you'll see results in a month.

entries.l1_note: 坚持练是 keep at (it)；keep up 是跟上。

entries.head: keep on

example.en: She kept on running even after the cramp.

entries.l1_note: keep on 是继续；keep at 强调不放弃。

entries.head: fall into

senses.en: to start doing something regularly without planning

example.en: I fell into the habit of walking after dinner.
example.zh: 我不知不觉养成了饭后散步的习惯。

entries.l1_note: 养成习惯是 fall into (the habit of)；不是 make a habit（也对，但少）。

entries.head: work off

example.en: That cake takes an hour to work off.
example.zh: 那块蛋糕得跑一小时才消耗掉。

entries.l1_note: 消耗掉是 work off；work out 是锻炼。

entries.head: burn off

senses.en: to use up energy or fat

example.en: Cycling burns off more than walking.

entries.l1_note: 燃烧掉是 burn off；burn out 是累垮。

entries.head: sweat off

example.en: He's trying to sweat off the holiday weight.
example.zh: 他想靠出汗减掉假期长的肉。

entries.l1_note: sweat off 常带调侃；sweat out 是发汗治病。

entries.head: measure up

example.en: The new coach didn't measure up to the last one.

entries.l1_note: 够格是 measure up (to)；不是“量尺寸”。

entries.head: limber up

example.en: Limber up before you start sprinting.

entries.l1_note: 拉伸热身是 limber up；warm up 更泛。

entries.head: work up

example.en: I worked up a sweat on the stairs.

entries.l1_note: 练出汗是 work up a sweat；work out 是锻炼。

entries.head: ease into

example.en: Ease into running with twenty minutes three times a week.
example.zh: 跑步先从每周三次、每次二十分钟开始。

entries.l1_note: 循序渐进是 ease into；不是“容易进去”。

entries.head: ease off

example.en: Ease off if your knee starts hurting.

entries.l1_note: 减量是 ease off；ease into 是慢慢开始。

entries.head: ramp up

example.en: Ramp up the distance by ten percent a week.

entries.l1_note: 加大是 ramp up；ramp down 是降低。

entries.head: scale back

example.en: He scaled back to three workouts a week.

entries.l1_note: 缩减是 scale back；scale up 是扩大。

entries.head: build in

senses.zh: 把某环节固定安排进去
senses.en: to include something as part of a plan

example.en: Build in a rest day after every three runs.
example.zh: 每跑三次安排一天休息。

entries.l1_note: 纳入计划是 build in；build up 是积累。

entries.head: warm down

senses.en: to do light exercise after a workout

example.en: Warm down with five minutes of walking.

entries.l1_note: 放松收尾是 warm down（英式也常用）；cool down 同义。

entries.head: stick with

senses.en: to continue with something without changing

example.en: Stick with this routine for six weeks.

entries.l1_note: 不换是 stick with；stick to 是遵守计划。

entries.head: keep to

senses.en: to follow a plan or limit

example.en: Try to keep to 1,800 calories a day.
example.zh: 尽量每天控制在一千八百卡。

entries.l1_note: 遵守是 keep to；keep up 是保持速度。

entries.head: slip back

senses.en: to return to an old habit

example.en: I slipped back into late-night snacking.
example.zh: 我又开始半夜吃零食了。

entries.l1_note: 退回旧习是 slip back (into)；slip up 是犯错。

entries.head: fall back

senses.en: to return to a worse state

example.en: Without a plan you'll fall back within a month.
example.zh: 没计划的话一个月就退回去。

entries.l1_note: 退回是 fall back；fall behind 是落后。

entries.head: get back into

example.en: I'm trying to get back into swimming.

entries.l1_note: 重新开始是 get back into；不是“回到里面”。

entries.head: start off

senses.en: to begin in a particular way

example.en: Start off with ten push-ups and add two a week.
example.zh: 先从十个俯卧撑开始，每周加两个。

entries.l1_note: start off 是起步方式；start out 也常用。

entries.head: build up to

senses.en: to increase gradually until you reach a level

example.en: Build up to a full marathon over six months.

entries.l1_note: 逐步加到是 build up to；build up 是积累。

entries.head: work up to

example.en: It took months to work up to pull-ups.
example.zh: 练了几个月才能做引体向上。

entries.l1_note: 练到是 work up to；work out 是锻炼。
collocations: work up to a heavier weight

entries.head: taper off

example.en: Taper off the week before the race.

entries.l1_note: 减量是 taper off；不是“变尖”。

entries.head: opt for

example.en: I opted for the morning class instead of evening.
example.zh: 我选了早课而不是晚课。

entries.l1_note: 选择是 opt for；比 choose 正式一点。

entries.head: stick at

senses.en: to continue doing something despite difficulty

example.en: She stuck at piano for ten years.

entries.l1_note: 坚持是 stick at (it)；stick to 是遵守。
